author: Tor Smith
title: Burglar snuck in through child's bedroom window, say Fremont police - NewsBreak
text:
By Tor Smith No media credit provided. ,
4 hours ago
(KRON) — The Fremont Police Department said an investigation is underway after a burglary suspect targeted a Village Common residence on July 25. No injuries were reported.
FPD said the homeowner reported they had returned from work to discover that the suspect had entered the home by removing the screen to her son’s bedroom window.
“The bedroom was ransacked, and several items were missing,” police said in a log of the incident. “The victim’s juvenile children were home at the time of the burglary but were unaware.”
Anyone with information tied to the case is encouraged to call police.
